title: Assessing the Sustainability and Trustworthiness of Federated Learning Models
reasoning: The paper develops a taxonomy and evaluation framework for 'Trustworthy Federated Learning' based on the AI-HLEG (High-Level Expert Group on AI) Ethics Guidelines. It includes and evaluates specific ethical pillars such as 'Fairness' (which covers non-discrimination) and 'Accountability' as part of its model assessment score.
